annotations.title: Get a drug or therapy program

description: Use this when the user asks about one drug or therapy program by its name or a code name (UBX-1325, BMS-986278): developers and partners, targets, mechanism, modality, indications with stage and source, lifespan evidence, published research, designations (orphan, breakthrough, fast track, PRIME), patents and exclusivity, development status by country, the next catalyst (a PDUFA date, an advisory committee, a readout) and the newest events from filings and regulators. A plan that includes drug and therapy programs reads every record in full; others read an outline, as on the site.

key.description: The asset's key or a code name.

name: get_asset
